item.title: 25-year-old Ocala man fatally ejected in crash on U.S. 27
item.description: A 25-year-old man from Ocala was killed on Monday morning after his pickup truck rear-ended another pickup truck, ejecting from his vehicle and onto U.S. Highway 27, where he was run over by a third pickup truck. item.title: Six more employees released by Marion County Fire Rescue for hazing incident
item.description: Officials announced on Friday that six additional employees, including the leadership that was on duty at the time, have been released from Marion County Fire Rescue following an internal review of a violent hazing incident that occurred last month. item.title: Ocala coffee drive-thru closes second location just 2 weeks after closing first
item.description: Less than three weeks after closing its first location, an Ocala coffee business has shuttered its remaining drive-thru, effectively ending the brand's presence in the city just 18 months after it began.
